output.brief: The August drop is mainly a cooling failure, not the contractor, the kiosks, or the survey. The chiller serving floors 6-8 (CH-2) failed from 4 to 19 August, and those floors were 26-29 C in occupied rooms. Their score fell to 6.8 during the outage and recovered to 8.4 after the repair. Floors 1-5 stayed steady, and the heat comments sit almost entirely on floors 6-8. Check-in, cleanliness and room inspection pass rates are flat. The survey method is unchanged. I am fairly confident about the chiller link, though I did not check the engineering interview or the telemetry. The 6% rate rise may have added to the value-score dip, but the data cannot separate it from the usual August pattern. Next: reinstate the deferred maintenance on both chillers, keep critical spare parts on site, and set a written guest-recovery protocol for cooling outages. Do not serve notice on Orrin, do not pull the kiosks, and do not exclude the August floor 6-8 responses from the score. Consider a return-stay offer for affected guests. Revisit the rate question once the value-score data is separated from seasonality.
